outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images (time-lapse photoactivation frames), not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

The main graphs in panel B are scatter/line plots where each dot represents an individual intensity measurement over time (not just an averaged summary statistic), with fitted model curves overlaid — so raw individual data points are already shown. The small insets summarizing 'average early time point responses' are essentially line plots of averaged data with error bars over a time axis, a plot type exempted from requiring overlaid individual points since doing so would make the dense time-series unreadable.
